alias: go2rtc - reload after HA start (restore camera WebRTC)
description: An HA restart can leave go2rtc unable to serve the Scrypted cameras' WebRTC (camera/webrtc/offer fails until go2rtc is reloaded, forcing live view onto the slow ~10s HLS fallback). This reloads go2rtc ~2 min after start so live view stays on the fast ~130ms WebRTC path.
